name: io.github.devchad-cmd/skilldb
title: SkillDB
description: A registry of 5,900+ peer-authored skills any MCP agent can search and load on demand.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server is the skilldb-mcp bin inside the skilldb package; plain `npx skilldb` launches the CLI instead.

environmentVariables.name: SKILLDB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SkillDB API key (optional — search/browse return metadata only without it; full skill content needs a free key from skilldb.dev/api-access).
